question: In which of the following states did NESTLE India Ltd. set up its first factory in 1961?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **NESTLE India Ltd.** set up its first factory in **1961** in the state of **Punjab**.
 
• This factory marked the beginning of Nestle's manufacturing operations in India.
 
• The choice of Punjab was strategic due to its rich agricultural base, which provided easy access to raw materials.
 
• The factory primarily focused on producing dairy products, which aligned with the state's strong dairy industry.
 
• Nestle's establishment in Punjab contributed to the industrial growth of the region and provided employment opportunities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **NESTLE India Ltd.** is a subsidiary of Nestlé S.A., a Swiss multinational food and drink processing conglomerate.
 
• The company has a significant presence in India with multiple manufacturing facilities across various states.
 
• Besides dairy products, NESTLE India Ltd. produces a wide range of products including beverages, prepared dishes, and cooking aids, chocolates, and confectioneries.
 
• The establishment of the factory in Punjab was a part of Nestle's broader strategy to cater to the Indian market and expand its global footprint.
